ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $250M Medicaid fraud scheme in Minnesota and follow the money to uncover the extent of the scheme
questions: Who is behind the alleged fraud scheme?
How much money was actually stolen?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money, we can track the flow of funds and identify key players.
